title: Cubeland
premise: A giant build-anything block world. The kids enter a build-off against the best teams on the server.

companion.name: GEL
companion.about: a bouncing green cube slime who eats blueprints and speaks in short happy blurbs

cast.ANA: architect; plans everything on graph paper
cast.MOSS: decorator; obsessed with color and plants

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, grass green, sky blue and warm brick palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.ana: a girl age 11 with medium brown skin, two puffy pigtails, a yellow hard hat and blue overalls
fragments.kai: a boy age 11 with light skin, messy black hair, a gray vest covered in pockets and goggles around his neck
fragments.moss: a kid age 11 with tan skin, short green-dyed hair, a leafy green sweater and a paint roller
fragments.dree: a girl age 11 with pale skin, a red ponytail, a red hoodie and fingerless gloves, mid-motion
fragments.gel: a small bouncy translucent green cube slime with two big dot eyes and a happy mouth
fragments.champs: three tall show-off kids age 12 in matching shiny gold vests
fragments.cubeland: a bright world made of chunky cube blocks: grass cubes, stone cubes, wood cubes, block trees and a build site with scaffolding
